=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:434-449 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The diagnostic tail is guarded only by pickle absence, so it can be skipped when build_index() succeeds but write_wrapper() later fails and leaves the pickle on disk.
  WHY: Several reviewers traced this to mark_unavailable() not removing the pickle after late wrapper-build failures, which preserves the file and prevents the tail from firing.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1240-1262 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The same pickle-absence gate can suppress the diagnostic tail when the wrapper build fails after the index has already been written.
  WHY: The workflow checks `[ ! -f "${SEMBLE_INDEX_PATH}" ]`, but late failures in build_semble_wrapper.sh leave the pickle present while logging the error to semple_index.log.
- scripts/build_semble_wrapper.sh:95-239 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: Overlapping custom paths can make the cleanup rm -rf delete the wrapper directory and break wrapper creation.
  WHY: Both reviewers noted that the index-path cleanup and wrapper-dir creation are not validated against path overlap, so a misconfigured SEMBLE_INDEX_PATH can remove the directory needed for write_wrapper().
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:289-1364 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The Build semble index steps do not explicitly export SEMBLE_INDEX_PATH, so the wrapper may fall back to an unexpected location.
  WHY: The workflow calls bash scripts/build_semble_wrapper.sh without the env var that other workflows set, and the wrapper defaults to ${RUNTIME_DIR:-${RUNNER_TEMP:-${PWD}}}/.semble-index.
- scripts/build_semble_wrapper.sh:67-76 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: mark_unavailable() sets SEMBLE_INDEX_AVAILABLE=false but does not remove the pickle file.
  WHY: If build_index() succeeds but write_wrapper() fails, the pickle remains on disk and the workflow's `[ ! -f "${semble_index_path}" ]` check skips the diagnostic tail.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:437-440 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Diagnostic tail gate does not fire on write_wrapper failures — comment/code mismatch.
  WHY: The workflow comments at orchestrate_poll.yml:437 and review_autofix.yml:1252 state "mark_unavailable() rms it on the failure path." This is false. mark_unavailable() (lines 84-92 of build_semble_wrapper.sh) never calls rm — it writes three env keys and exits 0. The only code path that cleans up the pickle is build_index()'s own failure branch (lines 155-157: `rm -rf "${index_path}" || true; mark_unavailable "index-build-failed"`).
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:434-449 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The diagnostic tail can miss some failure modes.
  WHY: If pickle.dump() writes a partial or corrupt file without raising, the file is present, the tail does not run, and downstream Semble failures are harder to debug.
- scripts/build_semble_wrapper.sh:103-104,157-158 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Path overlap can cause rm -rf to remove wrapper directory.
  WHY: The cleanup sequence `rm -rf "${index_path}" || true` followed by `mkdir -p "${wrapper_dir}" || true` is unsafe for deliberate overlapping custom paths.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:434-449 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The diagnostic tail only checks for the pickle file's absence, so it can miss wrapper-build failures after the index has been written.
  WHY: If build_index() succeeds but write_wrapper() fails, the pickle exists, the log tail is skipped, and operators do not see the "Semble wrapper unavailable" error.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1240-1249 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Same diagnostic gap as orchestrate_poll.yml.
  WHY: The tail condition keys only on pickle absence, but a build_index() success plus write_wrapper() failure leaves the pickle on disk while logging the real error to semple_index.log.
- scripts/build_semble_wrapper.sh:95-96,238-239 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Potential race condition in cleanup between build_index and write_wrapper.
  WHY: A custom SEMBLE_INDEX_PATH that overlaps wrapper_dir could make the rm -rf / mkdir -p cleanup sequence remove the wrapper directory and break wrapper creation.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:289-310,883-931,1316-1364 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The Build semble index steps do not export SEMBLE_INDEX_PATH before calling the shared script.
  WHY: Unlike orchestrate_poll.yml and implement.yml, these jobs invoke bash scripts/build_semble_wrapper.sh without the env var, so the wrapper may fall back to $PWD/.semble-index.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
